run.intermediate_state: Full model/head/Adam/scaler/progress/memory state and all development scores are replayed before temporary state deletion; retain state digest, exact score arrays and small receipts. Recompute intermediate models from the recorded run if later needed.
run.working_state: One GPU model; immutable original and shared temporary checkpoints. Branch-major execution; no cross-arm method inputs. Delete private memory and all temporary Adam states on exit.
run.historical_memory: Only the active ER ByteMemory may supply historical training inputs; offline benchmark labels and other arm archives are not method memory. No historical embedding cache.
run.runtime_check: One new CPU toy-encoder fixture exercises the production scheduler, data loader and publisher. Reuse the completed LaBSE component check; no repeated core smoke.
run.conclusion_boundary: Random same-source full-world arrivals and consumed development data; no distinct-domain BWT, real chronology, established forgetting, new selector or real-market effectiveness.

benchmark.threshold_rule: Unfitted logit >= 0 (probability >= 0.5) for all stages and arms, including stage zero.
benchmark.cumulative_schedule: At each stage reset original initialization and fresh Adam, train arrived prefix for five epochs; keep first-stage preprocessing.
benchmark.history_boundary: Offline benchmark packaging may read train truth once; method worksets include current worlds only, except the explicitly unbudgeted cumulative control. ER retains only its byte-budgeted records and RNG state.
benchmark.no_strong_definition: Neither verified_direct_token_count_log1p nor strong_rotation_path_count_log1p is positive.

component.numeric_input: Untransformed published legacy18 and identity33; first-arrival imputation and scaling only
component.scaler: Common original LaBSE in eval mode, before updates, only first-arrival public inputs; median fill and population mean/std fixed thereafter; float64 affine then float32 head
component.text_deduplication: Unique text per account and field; equal original-text weight. Share exact text encoding within one branch only.
component.chunking: Existing single-LaBSE chunk_text_exact; exact character reconstruction; no maximum chunk count or truncation
component.forward_precision: bfloat16 autocast encoder, float32 pooling and six aggregates
component.current_batch: One complete K28 world, all 378 edges, one mean BCE
component.replay_sampling: Uniform without replacement among retained edges per update
component.loss: mean_BCE(current) + mean_BCE(history); missing history contributes zero; sequential backward then one clip/update
component.memory_selection: Independent 64-bit random priority, arrival ordinal breaks ties; longest fitting prefix of the global random order, stop at first nonfitting edge. Cost-dependent inclusion, not uniform reservoir.
component.memory_record: 51 raw float64 values, one label byte, public endpoint IDs and full per-field unique redacted texts; no cross-edge deduplication
component.memory_accounting: 1024 actual serialized header bytes including padding and RNG/cutoff/stage state; 20 entry-header bytes plus each complete edge payload
component.memory_update: Once in unique canonical current-edge order after completing each stage; only prior-stage memory may train
component.randomness: Independent memory selection/replay RNG; stateless per-order/stage/epoch/step current/history dropout seeds. Current branch shape/order paired across sequential and ER.
component.state: One physical first-stage fit per arrival order; sequential and ER inherit identical encoder/head/nonempty optimizer. Cumulative resets original encoder/head and empty AdamW at each arrived prefix for two epochs; same first-stage scaler.
component.development: Fixed original 500-world candidate set; re-encode both endpoints at each changed checkpoint, publish/reload complete scores before separate Windows binary-label evaluation. Reuse unchanged metric functions; no qrels or Audit A/B reads.
component.claim_boundary: Within-new-representation comparisons only; random same-source arrivals are not domains or real chronology. No sole-unfreezing attribution, established forgetting, new selector contribution or real-market validation.
